event.description:
The Grand Archive Regionals are moving to Outpost Ghent! The highest level event in Belgium will allow participants to battle it out for some amazing prizes, including a Nationals Invite!
Due to a limited amount of spots, reservation is needed! You can reserve your spot by sending an Email to kevin@outpost.be
Doors: 10:00
Start: 11:00
Entry: 30€
Event link: https://omni.gatcg.com/events/33478
Number of rounds (swiss only and NO top cut):
9 - 16 players: 4 rounds
17 - 32 players: 5 rounds
33 - 50 players: 6 rounds
Participation Prizes:
-2 DTR boosters
-2 DTR event packs
-1 sapphire Pack
-1 set of Metal counters
-1 Proxia's vault pack
TOP 8 prize support:
1st: 1 box DTR (24 boosters) + 6 event packs + 6 Sapphire packs + 1 invite card + 1 finalist playmat + 1 champion playmat
2nd: 18 boosters DTR + 4 event packs + 5 sapphire packs + + 1 invite card + 1 finalist playmat
3rd - 4th: 10 boosters DTR + 3 event packs + 3 Sapphire packs + 1 invite card + 1 finalist playmat
5th - 8th: 3 boosters + 3 event packs + 2 Sapphire packs + 1 invite card + 1 finalist playmat
Deck Construction Rules:
Min 60-card main deck
Max 12 card material deck
15 point sideboard (Main deck card = 1p, material deck card=3p)
Format:
- Best 2 out of 3
- 60 minutes/round
- 5 minutes overtime (3 turns)
-------------------------
Join the Outpost Ghent Discord to stay in touch with fellow players:
https://discord.com/invite/RUnm7x83zH
